ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel surface with approximately 20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution localized in small, circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Black substrate background overlaid with white, annular (ring-shaped) geometric blobs distributed globally, with higher cluster density on the left lobe proximal to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an obtuse interior angle located at the vertical center of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude deviations along the entire trailing edge, forming a continuous serrated boundary against the background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges tapering towards pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Globally distributed white annular pixel clusters; specific high-density constellation visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertical and diagonal high-intensity (white) linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Tan-colored, textured pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique ring-patterned pixel formations (hollow circles) rather than solid white mottling, creating a distinct visual texture across the ventral surface.
